notes: Company background: mid-market SaaS provider for product analytics; customer-facing conversational assistant and doc search are top priorities.
Primary ask: predictable latency SLO (p95 <= 80ms for chat requests where possible), throughput ~200 req/s during peak for embeddings/rerank jobs.
Cost sensitivity: they care about unit cost — will consider quantized model variants if quality delta acceptable. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations.
Model preference: preference for open-models / Redwood-curated models; willing to evaluate both an 8-bit quantized ‘fast’ variant and a higher-quality fp16 variant as fallback.

Routing/fallback plan (POC): canary deploy with 5-10% traffic to Dedicated pool, metric gates on latency and quality, automated fallback to hosted API or a lower-cost model variant if error rate or latency crosses thresholds.
Region failover: want ability to route to eu-west for EU customers; test includes simulated zone outage to verify Canary->Fallback->Rollback sequence.
Rollback policy: immediate rollback condition if p99 latency > 500ms for >2 minutes or token error rate > 1%; SE suggested circuit-breaker + gradual rollback via Redwood rollouts.
Security: require SOC2 attestation and KMS integration for encryption at rest; retention controls for conversation data (30/90/365 day options).
Quote from product lead: 'Latency spikes are our #1 reliability pain — we need predictable tail latency more than raw throughput.'
Operational needs: per-route observability, token-level cost breakdown, and canary metrics in Console dashboards — asked for sample dashboards and alert playbook.
POC success criteria (agreed): p95 latency <= 85ms for chat under POC traffic patterns; reranker throughput >= 150 qps; no regression in QA test prompts (eval set pass rate >= 95%).
